title: Mixed Duo #046 · 여 글래머 아워글래스·GermanGlam / 남 대형 헤비·실버 포일
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the long reflecting pool path in front of the Taj Mahal with pale marble paving, a waist-high ornamental rail and low steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult German woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver barrel-shaped weight, a tin cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop with a heavy rough copper a pyramid-shaped lump hanging at its end, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum anklets. Extremely long almond nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder), wide gold-powder bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense gold powder glittering densely filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Spanish man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, silver foil-lined eyes with a cool shimmer, smooth warm olive skin, a playful half-grin, bold vivid magenta-pink hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a bronze cube-shaped block, a gold barrel-shaped weight, a tin small flared temple bell, a bronze hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold hair ornaments. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large giant of a man, far beyond any real person, big-bellied with great size throughout. Broad powerful shoulders, a wide heavy chest, a large round soft belly hanging over a thick waist, thick strong arms, and wide heavy thighs beneath. Every curve is large, solid and continuous, with a warm, imposing bearing. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice fills filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands on his hips, elbows out.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme red needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
